description: Kohinoor Textile Mills Limited was founded as a private limited entity in 1953 and has been publicly listed since 1968. It is a vertically integrated textile manufacturer whose operations span spinning, weaving, processing and home textiles. Its spinning and home textile units are at Peshawar Road, Rawalpindi, its spinning unit at Gulyana Road, Gujar Khan, and its weaving unit at 8-K.M. Manga Raiwind Road, District Kasur; the company is part of KMLG.
sourceNote: Written from: https://www.kmlg.com/ktml/profile/, https://www.kmlg.com/ktml/governance/ and https://www.kmlg.com/ktml/contact-us/ (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Yarn
products.summary: Cotton and synthetic yarns in a wide range of counts, spun on ring, MVS and open-end rotor machinery.

products.name: Greige fabric
products.summary: Griege fabrics woven on 384 looms at the Raiwind unit.

products.name: Dyed and printed fabric
products.summary: Dyeing and printing of fabrics for the home textile sector at the Rawalpindi unit.

products.name: Home textile products
products.summary: Bed linen, quilting, embroidery, curtains and similar made-ups, stitched for the export market.
